title: Náutico tries to maintain historical advantage against Cuiabá in Série B
seoTitle: Náutico seeks historical edge over Cuiabá in Série B
subtitle: With just one change in the midfield, the coach looks to repeat the favorable record against Dourado
excerpt: Náutico faces Cuiabá in the 29th round of Série B with a single midfield adjustment, seeking to extend its historical lead.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Náutico and Cuiabá, scheduled for next Monday, stands out because the two teams are separated by just two points in the standings and the duel could change the position of both on the table.

Náutico takes to the field with a midfield doubt

Coach Guilherme dos Anjos reported that the only expected change for the match will be the substitution of defensive midfielder Samuel, who is suspended. Auremir, Pato Núñez, and Caio Soares are the direct contenders for the spot, with Guilherme as an additional option, although not the choice to start.

Absences and returns in Náutico's squad

In addition to Samuel's absence, center-back Léo Índio remains out due to a femur injury. Forward Júnior Todinho, who missed the previous round due to a viral infection, has recovered and is available. Right-back Arnaldo returns from suspension, while Paulo Sérgio remains a doubt, despite being cleared by the medical department. Defensive midfielder Luiz Felipe continues to be out.

History between Náutico and Cuiabá

In five encounters, Náutico has won four and lost only one, with no draws recorded. The only defeat occurred in 2020, when Cuiabá won 1–0. In the two 2018 Copa do Brasil matches, Timbu won 2–1 and 1–0. In the first round of the current edition of the Second Division, Náutico also came out on top, winning 1–0 at the Aflitos.

Table situation and importance of the duel

Náutico occupies 14th place with 38 points and has been winless for two rounds, following a 3–3 draw with Operário and a 2–1 loss to América-MG. Cuiabá, in 11th, has 40 points and is coming off a 3–0 win over Athletic and a 1–1 draw with Novorizontino. The result in Cuiabá could bring Dourado closer to the top of the table and represents a recovery attempt for Timbu.

With information from ge, Terra.
